note: AI-assisted reading (Claude) of final_cases_digest.md, written after the 67 cases were frozen (final_cases_FREEZE.json) and re-derived. Not a human adjudication. human_required marks the minimum a person must adjudicate before any production use: links the tier would publish whose acceptance rests on the version check or on a policy question, and released DIRECT edges whose registration contradicts them. Excluded references publish nothing and are not required.

verdicts.LINK_SUPPORTED: eligible under v2; the original labels support the source identity and the source's own product-scoped MANUFACTURE statement
verdicts.LINK_SUPPORTED_WITH_CAVEAT: eligible under v2 and supported, but what the link says is weak or easily misread (see rationale)
verdicts.CORRECTLY_EXCLUDED: excluded, and the stated reason holds in the original labels
verdicts.EXCLUDED_PLAUSIBLE_LINK: excluded by a rule, though the link is probably right; a conservative loss of coverage, not an error
verdicts.QUARANTINE_CORRECT_DIFFERENT_PRODUCT: v1 linked it; at the date the citing label was published the source described a different physical product (another mark, or another strength of the same source)
verdicts.QUARANTINE_CORRECT_DESCRIPTION_NOISE: v1 linked it; the descriptions disagree at the relevant date, but only in a way typical of transcription or coding (one character, a coded field); not validated, probably not a false link
verdicts.QUARANTINE_CORRECT_UNVERIFIABLE: v1 linked it; v2 cannot confirm it (no source version by the relevant date, no archived version, a field not stated, or no product-scoped site named at the relevant date)

precision_question: Random precision sample (frozen at 43b3c5b before any check). Is the cited source the finished drug this product repackages (same product, strength, form and physical description), and does the source's own label name the evidence site with MANUFACTURE for that product?
